up: Find all compounds that appear in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4665541'. For each compound, return the compound's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). Include compounds even if they lack a SMILES entry. Do not add any extra filters. Ensure each distinct compound appears only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type AS type, cs.canonical_smiles AS smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4665541';
